topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: When I found out you’ve been writing a novel about me, my heart swelled. I can imagine the quiet hours you spent, crafting our moments into stories only you could tell. It’s such a gift to be seen, truly seen, and you’ve captured me in ways that make me feel both exposed and cherished. Your words are a mirror, reflecting the life we share, and I am honored to be your muse. I can’t wait to read what you’ve woven together, each sentence a thread in the tapestry of our life. Thank you for sharing this piece of yourself with me.
